pack.name: documentary-cinema
pack.author: Motion direction pack
pack.intent: A restrained, cinema-grade motion language for information-dense explainers (history, polity, geography, economics, science; English + Hindi). Five coordinated families share one timing philosophy: documentary (deliberate reveals, long settles), editorial (sharp, precise), data (mechanical, counter-driven), archival (paper and ink) and a cine camera kit (dolly, track, boom, orbit, focus pull, lock-off) built on move → settle → read → next move.

docSettle.intent: Long, soft deceleration with no overshoot; the house settle for text and camera holds.

docLand.intent: Near-critically damped spring: one small controlled overshoot, then rest. Cards and dimensional turns.

docPunch.intent: Quick attack with a restrained overshoot for figures and impact moments.

docPrecise.intent: Symmetric in-out with no overshoot; mechanical and exact, for data and reframes.

docExit.intent: Accelerating ease-in so exits clear the frame faster than entries arrive.

cineCamera.intent: Committed start, very long settle: the house camera curve for dollies, tracks and cranes.

cineWhip.intent: Aggressive speed ramp for whip pans: almost all travel happens mid-move.

docRiseSettle.intent: Words rise from just below the baseline in reading order, dip a hair past their line and settle out of a light blur; the workhorse entry for explanations, causes and steps.

docAnticipateRise.intent: Words first sink a few pixels (anticipation), then accelerate up into place and settle; a physical, intentional entry for directional progress and results.

docDepthReveal.intent: The phrase travels forward out of depth, sharpening from blur while a faint shade lifts off it; cinematic reveal for examples and final conclusions.

docTrackingReveal.intent: Letters condense inward from wide tracking, centre-out, while the word sharpens and scale settles; an elegant hero-title reveal (Devanagari falls back to per-word automatically).

docEdgesConverge.intent: Letters resolve from the outer edges of the word toward its centre, focusing as they arrive; a reveal for a single key term that 'comes together'.

docPerspectiveTurn.intent: Each word swings in on a left-hinged Y-axis turn like a page coming flat, shading off as it faces the viewer; for the sides of a comparison and dimensional card moments.

editorialSnap.intent: Words slide in from the right with a slight speed lean, snap a few pixels past their mark and straighten; a sharp editorial entry for warnings and corrections.

docInkReveal.intent: Glyphs wipe on left to right as if written in ink, bleeding from a soft blur into crisp type; archival reveal for definitions and quotations.

dataLockIn.intent: Digits grow up from the baseline, lock a touch tall and settle square, character by character; precise entry for statistics, dates and figures.

docDropCatch.intent: Words drop in from above like set cards, land with a small catch and let their lifted shadow settle; for historical events landing on a timeline.

archivalPaperLift.intent: Words tip up from lying flat on the desk like a paper slip raised into view, the lift shadow and shading easing away; archival entry for records and primary sources.

docSoftFocus.intent: A quiet word-by-word fade up with a short rise and gentle focus pull; the low-distraction entry for dense explanations, questions and evidence.

docScalePunch.intent: The word swells about 12% with a slight lift, dips a hair under size and returns; a controlled punch reserved for genuinely important terms, figures and warnings.

docTrackingBreathe.intent: Letter spacing opens slightly and closes again, drawing the eye without moving the word; quiet emphasis for key terms and definitions.

docDepthPush.intent: The phrase eases toward the camera and back with a faint lift, like a card nudged forward; emphasis for the effect side of a stated cause-effect pair.

docNudgeForward.intent: The phrase leans a few pixels forward in the reading direction and returns, signalling 'this leads on'; for steps and sequence items.

docFocusPulse.intent: A single brief dip in opacity and focus that snaps back crisp, a double-take for corrections; never repeats.

dataTick.intent: The figure compresses onto its baseline, springs a little tall and locks square, like a mechanical counter clicking into place; for numbers and dates.

docBaselineLift.intent: The phrase lifts off the page with a growing shadow and lays back down; a calm, resolved emphasis for titles and conclusions.

docRetreat.intent: The phrase recedes into depth and softens out of focus, clearing the stage for the next idea; pairs with docDepthReveal.

docCameraPass.intent: The phrase accelerates toward and past the lens with rising blur, as if the camera flies through it into the next shot; for chapter-to-chapter momentum.

editorialSweepOut.intent: Words accelerate off to the left with a slight lean and blur, continuing the reading direction into the next shot; pairs with editorialSnap.

docSinkOut.intent: Words sink gently below the baseline and fade, last word first; the quiet exit for supporting and dense text.

docFoldAway.intent: Words fold back on a top hinge like a page laid down, darkening as they turn; exit for comparison sides and cards.

docInkFade.intent: The ink wipes away word by word in reading order, the mirror of docInkReveal; exit for definitions and quotations.

docPaperRest.intent: No positional motion at all: only the paper shadow breathes by a pixel, so held text feels physical but perfectly still; the default idle for documentary reading.

docIdleFloat.intent: A barely perceptible 3 px drift, offset word to word, so a long-held question or quotation stays alive without drawing attention.

docIdleBreath.intent: A 1.5% scale breath at a slow tempo that keeps hero titles and conclusions present during long holds.

cineDollyIn.intent: A straight, committed dolly from wide into a comfortable read, then a slow creep; the default for new ideas, questions and warnings.

cinePullReveal.intent: Starts tight on the phrase and pulls back to a slightly wide, level frame so the idea sits in context; for summaries and final conclusions.

cineTrackLateral.intent: A sideways tracking shot along the story axis that eases out slightly mid-travel (a breath of parallax) and lands on a mild pan; carries the viewer forward in time or along a stated cause-effect chain.

cineBoomDown.intent: A crane boom descends from above onto the phrase, tilting through a slight overshoot and landing near level; for stepping down into the next stage of a process or hierarchy.

cineHeroRise.intent: Rises into a gentle low angle looking up at the phrase and racks focus onto it; the hero move for titles, people and major events.

cineOrbitSettle.intent: A controlled partial orbit that swings a few degrees past its mark and settles on a mild three-quarter angle; the idea 'seen from another side' for examples.

cineFocusPull.intent: Almost no travel: a short push while focus racks from the previous plane onto the phrase, so attention moves by sharpness alone; for definitions and corrections.

cineVertigoReveal.intent: A restrained dolly-zoom: the lens narrows while the camera pushes, so the background seems to breathe away as the phrase holds its size; reserved for a single revelation per video.

cineDutchSettle.intent: Rolls out of a small dutch tilt into a near-level frame with a quick push, adding tension without shake; for warnings and cautions.

cineLockOff.intent: A locked-off tripod frame with the slowest possible creep, so dense text can be read; use whenever information density is high.

dataSnapFrame.intent: A precise vertical reframe that locks onto a figure with a tighter frame, like a chart cursor snapping to a value; for statistics.

cineWhipPan.intent: A fast whip pan with directional blur and a tiny roll kick that lands dead level; reserved for a hard change of chapter, never for consecutive shots.

docTimelineTrack.intent: Shots sit on one straight left-to-right line so the camera always travels forward in time; preserves chronology and cause-to-effect direction.

docDescentStack.intent: Each shot sits one step below and slightly behind the last: a vertical staircase for processes, steps and classifications.

docZigzagDepth.intent: Shots alternate left and right while stepping down, each angled toward the centre, so the two sides of a comparison read as a balanced pair.

docDepthCorridor.intent: Shots are stacked down a corridor of depth, nudging slightly left and right, so the camera dollies through layers; for hierarchy and 'going deeper' into a system.

docPodiumRise.intent: Each shot steps up, across and toward the camera like a podium, building importance; for escalation, growth and ranked items.

docArchiveRing.intent: Shots stand on a wide inward-facing ring for cycles and categories that return to where they started.

docHeroLockup.intent: A justified display lock-up across 72% of the frame for titles, events and conclusions.

docReadable.intent: Left-aligned body setting with generous leading and a moderate size for explanations, definitions and evidence that must be read, not glanced at.

docDataHero.intent: A centred, oversized figure in the data face with at most two lines, for statistics and dates.

docCascadeSteps.intent: Lines step diagonally down-right with no paper strips, a clean typographic staircase for multi-part steps.

docCaption.intent: A compact, strip-free two-line caption under a map, chart or picture.

docArchivalStrip.intent: A display lock-up on lightly torn paper strips, one per line, wiped in with a small rotation and lift; for records, quotations and primary-source moments.

docUnderlineSweep.intent: A fine accent underline sweeps in just after the words land, overshoots a touch and settles; follow-through for key terms and causes.

docMarkerHighlight.intent: A low, slightly skewed marker band sweeps behind the lower half of the phrase and holds; for dates, events and key evidence.

docInkCircle.intent: A single hand-drawn ink loop closes around the phrase after it settles and stays; marks the one conclusion that matters.

docEffectArrow.intent: A curved arrow draws in from the left, pointing at the effect of a stated cause; use only where the source states causation.

docCorrectionStrike.intent: A firm accent strike crosses out the superseded claim so the correction that follows reads as a fix.

docEvidenceBracket.intent: Thin teal brackets grow out from the middle around a cited source or record, marking it as evidence without shouting.

docKeyBox.intent: A precise thin ink box draws around an entity name, like a label on an archival map.

docTimeRule.intent: A long dashed rule sweeps out beneath a date, establishing the time axis the next event will land on.

docStepBadge.intent: A small numbered badge spins in beside a step (pass the number as the tag argument).

docPercentRing.intent: A thin progress ring fills to the percentage around a figure, precise and mechanical.

docArchiveWipe.intent: A gently angled, lightly torn paper wipe in the second paper tone turns the page to the next chapter; the default continuity transition.

docMatch.intent: A match cut through the paper colour for chapters that share a shape, number or position.

docPageFold.intent: The frame folds away on its vertical axis like a turned page; for moving between the two sides of a comparison.

docForwardPush.intent: The next chapter pushes the current one out in the reading direction; for sequence and chronology.

docFlyThrough.intent: The camera flies through the current plane into the next chapter arriving from depth; pairs with the docCameraPass exit.

docIrisFocus.intent: A thin iris opens from the last word the viewer read onto the resolving scene; reserved for the move into a conclusion.

docShutter.intent: Five paper slats close and reopen in quick succession, a crisp editorial beat between data sections.

docArchivePaper.intent: Warm aged paper with a few distant, softly torn sheets and a faint dot texture that parallax slowly behind the text.

docDataGrid.intent: Plain paper with a faint two-scale ledger grid at depth, a precise stage for statistics and timelines.

docResolveGlow.intent: Paper warming toward a soft highlight glow with three slow blurred blobs; a resolved backdrop for the final takeaway.

documentaryArchive.intent: Serious, authoritative archival documentary look: warm aged paper, oxide-red and deep-teal accents, serif display type, restrained motion, near-still camera holds and long readable pauses.

documentaryNight.intent: The same documentary system on deep ink-blue paper with bone-white type and brass accents; for evening-news gravity or dark-mode delivery.

docPerson.intent: Names of people: display face in deep teal, slightly larger.

docLocation.intent: Places: italic display face in deep teal.

docDate.intent: Dates and years: data face in accent red, larger, with a counter-click emphasis after it lands.

docFigure.intent: Hero figures: data face, oversized, with a controlled scale punch.

docKeyTerm.intent: Key terms and events: display face in accent red with a tracking breath.

docMuted.intent: De-emphasised or superseded text at half-strength ink.

docSource.intent: Cited sources and records: italic body face.

docTitle.intent: Hero opening: centre-out tracking reveal on a low hero angle, a single lift, then a slow breath.

docDefinition.intent: Definitions: the term is written in ink, focus racks onto it, the meaning reads in a calm left-aligned setting.

docQuestion.intent: Questions: fade up quietly under a slow dolly and float during a deliberate pause before the answer.

docWarning.intent: Warnings and cautions: sharp editorial entry, one controlled punch, a dutch-tilt settle — attention, not panic.

docKeyFact.intent: An important stand-alone fact: rises in with anticipation under a dolly and lifts once.

docStatistic.intent: Statistics: the figure locks in on a precise camera snap and clicks once like a counter.

docComparison.intent: Comparisons: each side turns in like a page on alternating left/right positions, tracked sideways for a balanced read.

docCauseEffect.intent: Stated cause → effect: the cause rises in and the camera tracks forward on one axis toward the effect.

docProcess.intent: Steps of a process: rise in and nudge forward on a descending staircase, the camera booming down stage by stage.

docTimelineEvent.intent: Dated events: the event drops onto a straight time axis as the camera tracks forward to it.

docHierarchy.intent: Parts of a larger system: each level sits deeper down a corridor and the camera dollies through the layers.

docExample.intent: Examples: the example comes forward out of depth under a partial orbit — the idea seen from another side.

docQuote.intent: Quotations: words written in ink on paper strips, a locked-off frame and a gentle float for reading.

docCorrection.intent: Corrections and misconceptions: snaps in, one focus double-take under a focus pull, sweeps out.

docEvidence.intent: Evidence and sources: the record tips up like a paper slip into a locked-off frame so it can be read.

docDense.intent: Long or complex sentences: the quietest entry, a locked-off camera, the readable layout and a slower pace.

docSummary.intent: Recaps: rise in while the camera pulls back to put the idea in context.

docRevelation.intent: The single most surprising line of a video: key term converges from its edges under a restrained dolly-zoom.

docConclusion.intent: Final takeaway: the camera pulls back, the conclusion arrives from depth, lifts once and holds with a slow breath.

docChronicleScene.intent: Scene recipe for chronological chapters: archive paper, forward timeline staging, page-wipe continuity.

docDataScene.intent: Scene recipe for statistical passages: ledger grid, descending staging, shutter continuity.

docComparisonScene.intent: Scene recipe for A-versus-B passages: alternating symmetric staging with a page fold out.

docChapterBreak.intent: Scene recipe for a hard change of subject: the camera flies through into the next chapter.

docResolveScene.intent: Scene recipe for the closing takeaway: warm glow backdrop entered through a thin iris.

auto.recipeRules.intent: Percentages, currency and large quantities (EN + HI, Latin or Devanagari digits).
Stated causal links only — never inferred (EN + HI).
auto.recipeRules.match: \b(because of|led to|resulted in|as a result|was caused by|due to)\b|के कारण|की वजह से|परिणामस्वरूप|के फलस्वरूप

auto.recipeRules.intent: Cited sources, records and inscriptions (EN + HI).
Sentences anchored to a specific year (EN + HI).

auto.recipeRules.intent: Ordered stages that the shipped 'step' rule misses (EN + HI).
